why: A paper by Julia Stadlmann (arXiv:2608.31126, Aug 2026) improves the unconditional bound on infinitely-occurring prime gaps (H1) from 246, the Polymath/Zhang-era value cited on the twin prime conjecture's own Wikipedia page, down to 240; several claimed full proofs of the conjecture also surfaced in 2025 but appear unvetted/likely erroneous.
